subject.title: [Feature]: Thread replies when agent uses tools; top-level for conversational responses

question: Should Slack support a default-off tool-use-sensitive reply-placement mode, and should it extend `replyToMode` or live as a separate `channels.slack.thread.replyOnToolUse` flag?
rationale: This would add operator-visible Slack config and change visible reply placement after tool use, so implementation needs maintainer intent on precedence, streaming behavior, and upgrade semantics.

options.title: Extend Reply Mode
options.body: Add an explicit Slack reply-placement policy under the existing `replyToMode` family so account, chat-type, and per-channel precedence stay in one model.

options.title: Add Separate Flag
options.body: Add the proposed default-off `thread.replyOnToolUse` flag and document how it overrides or composes with existing reply modes, DMs, streaming, and tool sends.

options.title: Decline Heuristic
options.body: Keep static `replyToMode` and per-channel overrides as the supported way to reduce Slack clutter, and document that OpenClaw does not infer thread placement from tool use.

recommendation.title: Extend Reply Mode
recommendation.body: Add an explicit Slack reply-placement policy under the existing `replyToMode` family so account, chat-type, and per-channel precedence stay in one model.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the closest static reply-placement change and has recent history on the Slack threading/config surface.
